（2025/12）
oddovv
在不断变化的潮流与信息环境中，我希望建立一个属于自己的品牌，将日常观察、情绪感受与视觉想象转化为可以被触摸和分享的创作，记录下此人生阶段的思考。

通过探索日常物件以及个人经历，oddovv 逐渐成为我表达自我与记录灵感的一种方式。每一件作品都不仅是一件物品，也承载着某段时间里的情绪、故事与想象。
>
（2025/11）
AI-assisted Web Experiments
这个项目源于我对于设计与技术结合可能性的兴趣。
我尝试通过 vibe coding 的方式，将自己的视觉想法、创意概念与交互体验转化为真实存在的小型网页作品。

通过不同的网站实验，探索数字空间中的视觉表达、互动方式以及个人创作的新可能。
（2025/9）
Girlism
《少女主义》是一项围绕少女身份、自我表达与个人成长展开的视觉概念创作项目。

项目受到古典艺术、女性符号以及当代文化的启发，通过视觉叙事与美学探索，以视觉语言、象征符号以及概念创作，创造一个允许个体自由表达、探索自我，并重新理解"少女"意义的精神空间。

More than once along the way, we found ourselves talking about the lives of the people who call this place home.

Did they feel a sense of peace from living day after day among these vast, undulating mountains, or did the mountains instead leave them feeling restless and confined?

Would the children here choose to leave one day, and would they ever find themselves missing the cattle and sheep that had grown alongside them?
As I drove through the truly undulating mountains, seeing the Yarlung Tsangpo River and glaciers that have endured for millennia, once only words in my mind, everything suddenly felt worth it.
At least for us, in those moments, we were immensely happy, even if it meant spending two whole days on the road inside a car.

WHo am I？？
2024/9-2026
I’m w, a creative practitioner from the School of Communication at Shenzhen University, majoring in New Media and Communication.

My background in communication has shaped the way I observe the relationship between people, media, and culture. Through learning about digital platforms, content creation, and audience behaviors, I gradually became interested in how ideas can be transformed into meaningful experiences.

After exploring different creative practices through two internship experiences, I began building my own independent creative brand and experimenting with visual design, digital experiences, and AI-assisted creation.

I see myself as a creator who works across design, media, and technology, constantly exploring new ways to turn observations and imagination into tangible works.
